title: Cofinal finite affine etale coverings of a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object
statement: Let $U$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], viewed as an object of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For every jointly surjective family of etale morphisms $(T_a\to U)_{a\in A}$, there are a finite set $B$, indices $a(b)\in A$, and affine schemes $V_b$ with etale maps $V_b\to U$, each factoring through $T_{a(b)}\to U$, such that $(V_b\to U)_{b\in B}$ is jointly surjective and every fibre product $V_b\times_UV_{b'}$ is quasi-compact. Equivalently, finite affine etale coverings with quasi-compact pairwise fibre products form a cofinal system of coverings of $U$. This is the refinement used in Etale Cohomology, Section 59.51, Tag 03Q4, for Sites, Lemma Tag 0738.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section 59.51, Tag 03Q4 (label section-colimit), first paragraph, using Topologies, Lemma Tag 0218 (label lemma-etale-affine) and Sites, Lemma Tag 0738 (label lemma-directed-colimits-sections)

proof.text: Convert the covering sieve to joint surjectivity with Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The over-category commutativity identity identifies each (f a).left with (T a).hom. Construct the etale scheme cover C with Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers.

Use the Mathlib declaration recorded for [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-affine-refinement], QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom, in its actual generality: it assumes only CompactSpace of the base, not affineness. Etale structure maps are open by Scheme.Hom.isOpenMap (Morphisms/UniversallyOpen.lean:48 and the flat, locally finitely presented instance), so QuasiCompactCover.of_isOpenMap supplies its remaining hypothesis. Obtain a finite affine etale cover D and a refinement g : D.cover ⟶ C. This is a direct application of the recorded Lean declaration, rather than an application of the narrower natural-language affine-base specialization.

Reindex the finite type D.I₀ by B = ULift (Fin (Fintype.card D.I₀)), in the required universe w, using Equiv.ulift and Fintype.equivFin. Put V b = Scheme.Etale.mk (D.f (e b)). Each member is a spectrum and is affine. The refinement component g.h₀ (e b), with g.w₀ (e b), defines its factorization through T (g.s₀ (e b)); equality of over-category morphisms is equality of their left components. Joint surjectivity follows from D.cover.iUnion_range and the surjective reindexing identity Function.Surjective.iUnion_comp. Convert back to the small etale topology using [def-weil-pbc-etale-site].

Each spectrum V b is compact by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact](iii). Since U is quasi-separated, each structure map V b → U is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1); its base change to V b′ is quasi-compact by (3), and the pullback is compact by (2). Lean infers these instances using quasiCompact_of_compactSpace (Morphisms/QuasiSeparated.lean:255) and the CompactSpace pullback instance (Morphisms/QuasiCompact.lean:190). This proves the final clause and hence the cofinal refinement assertion.

lean.statement: theorem etale_qcqs_cofinal_finite_affine_coverings {U : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U] {A : Type v} (T : A → U.Etale) (f : ∀ a, T a ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U)) (hf : Sieve.ofArrows T f ∈ U.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U))) : ∃ (B : Type w) (_ : Finite B) (a : B → A) (V : B → U.Etale) (v : ∀ b, V b ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U)), (∀ b, IsAffine (V b).left) ∧ (∀ b, ∃ h : V b ⟶ T (a b), h ≫ f (a b) = v b) ∧ Sieve.ofArrows V v ∈ U.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U)) ∧ (∀ b b', CompactSpace (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (V b).hom (V b').hom))
